stem.text: In the circuit shown, the battery and ammeter have negligible resistance.

stem.alt: Circuit with a 12 V cell and an ammeter A, with open terminals labelled X and Y at the two ends of the circuit.

stem.text: The following combinations of resistors are each separately placed between the terminals X and Y of the circuit.
Which combination would give an ammeter reading of $8\,\text{A}$?

A.alt: Circuit of a 1 Ω resistor in series with two resistors in parallel, a 2 Ω resistor and a 3 Ω resistor, between two terminals.

B.alt: Circuit of a 2 Ω resistor in series with two resistors in parallel, a 1 Ω resistor and a 3 Ω resistor, between two terminals.

C.alt: Circuit of a 1 Ω resistor and a 2 Ω resistor in series in one branch, in parallel with a 3 Ω resistor, between two terminals.

D.alt: Circuit of three resistors, 2 Ω, 1 Ω and 3 Ω, in parallel between two terminals.
